passes.notes: Both answers use the same approach: a media query with clamp(…, 10vw, …), giving about 39px at 390px with tight leading. Either one should put the headline on 2-4 lines without horizontal overflow. A keeps every change inside the media query and adds a useful reminder about the viewport meta tag. B applies text-wrap: balance globally, which can change where the desktop headline breaks; B mentions this, but it conflicts with the request to leave desktop alone.

Both answers make the headline about 39px on a 390px phone, keep the line spacing tight and should wrap it to about three lines without horizontal overflow. A adds text-wrap: balance outside the media query, so it can change desktop line breaks; A admits this, but it still breaks the 'leave desktop alone' request. B keeps every change inside the media query, keeps the lead at a readable 17px, and adds the useful reminder about the viewport meta tag.
